// Reconstruction of the mistaken snippet: the image was forwarded to a
// pre-existing input that belongs to the messaging overlay, so it attached
// to an open chat draft instead of the post.
(() => {
  const target = document.querySelector('input[id^="attachment-input"]');
  const dt = new DataTransfer();
  dt.items.add(new File([stagedBytes], 'diagram.png', { type: 'image/png' }));
  target.files = dt.files;
  target.dispatchEvent(new Event('change', { bubbles: true }));
  return target.id;
})()
